Hi Elena — great speaking earlier. As discussed, we’d love to capture a short on-camera testimonial with one of your clinical leads (15–90s clips, condensed into a ~2 minute case highlight).

Proposed scope:
- 1 interview block (30–45 minutes) + 20–30m b-roll with clinician and platform screens
- Simple single-location shoot at your HQ (conference room + adjacent workspace)
- Deliverables: 2–3 short cutdowns for web + one 90s case highlight

To keep this lightweight for your team, I attached a draft release (NDH_Release_v2.docx) and a rough shot list (ndh_shot_list_v1.pdf). Can you confirm:
1) Who will be the on-camera participant?
2) Any legal/privacy constraints we should know about (PHI concerns, sign-off chain)?
3) Preferred shoot window: week of Nov 9 or Nov 16?

Logistics note: Redwood will cover travel for a single shooter and provide a small appearance fee to the participant. Final studio call time will be shared once we lock the date.

If it helps, Ben (cc’d) is our production lead and can share the technical rider.

Thanks — excited to partner on this.

Best,

Hi all — tagging in production details and the run-of-show. I’m attaching the shot list and a draft run-of-show (ndh_shot_list_v1.pdf). Quick summary of tech/crew:
- Crew: 1 shooter (Tom) + 1 sound tech (local hire) — minimal footprint
- Kit: 2x cameras (interview + B-roll), lav mic for Dr. Malik, small LED fill, gimbal for walk-and-talk b-roll
- Time estimate: 3.5 hours onsite (setup 45m, interview 45m, b-roll 60m, wrap 20–30m)
- Files: rushes delivered via secure link within 72 hours; first cut in 7 business days

Suggested on-camera talking points (short prompts we’ll send to Dr. Malik):
- Brief role & background: who you serve and scale (team size/patient volume)
- Problem: the inference challenge that led you to Redwood
- Decision: why Redwood (performance, cost, reliability examples — 1 metric if possible)
- Outcome: short quantifiable benefit + one specific customer story (non-PHI)
- Close: what you’d tell a peer evaluating inference platforms

On release/legal: we’ll accept a redline but prefer to keep a 2-year usage window and rights to use in marketing channels (web, social, events). We’ll prepare a DocuSign-ready release and share by EOD Oct 31.

Any on-site constraints we should slot into the run-of-show? (e.g., quieter rooms, patient flow windows).

— Ben

- Location: NextDoor Health, 3rd floor conference room (Elena to confirm room access & AV closet key)
